description: Tallan's Calendar Visual offers an exciting way to display and filter date related data. View the aggregation of data across a range of dates in a standard calendar layout. The visualization offers separate views for year and month, allowing users to zoom in on date ranges while presenting them clearly and effectively. Features include: A Standard Calendar Layout Year and Month Views Standard Visual Formatting Options Control and Shift Key Board Commands to select date ranges on standard calendar view Drill down (preview)
